en.sayed-ali-raza: I have come to know that
every one of them entered upon Muslim women and other women under protection of Islam
and took away their ornaments from legs, arms, necks and ears
and no woman could resist it except by pronouncing the verse, “We are for Allāh and to Him we shall return.” (Qur’ān, 2:156)
Then they got back laden with wealth
without any wound or loss of life.
If any Muslim dies of grief after all this he is not to be blamed but rather there is justification for him before me.
